title: Pothole Racing
premise: Wren, Dax and Ola are fixing a rusty go-cart to race it at the county fair. Every video, the top comment decides what they do next.
rules: One small, real step per episode. No early wins.
Counters on screen come from series.json only. Never invent a number.
Open with a one-line recap of the last episode, then the new problem inside 3 seconds.
End on a vote the comments can answer.
Thank the commenter whose idea decided this episode, by the comment.

episodes.title: The cart in the garage
episodes.summary: We found a rusty go-cart in Mr. Pell's garage. Steering or brakes first?

decidedBy.comment: Fix the steering first, brakes can wait

next.brief: Fix the steering. End on the brakes problem.
